task.name: Pull Request Size Policy Enforcement
task.description: Review newly opened and updated pull requests and surface only pull requests whose net changed lines exceed a repository-defined review-size threshold without an already tracked or explicitly accepted exception.
task.intent: Reduce operator time spent discovering oversized pull requests that are harder to review safely while avoiding duplicate attention on size exceptions that are already tracked or explicitly accepted.
activationConditions: A pull request is opened or synchronized within the evidence window in a repository covered by the workflow policy.
Authoritative repository pull request evidence shows the pull request exceeds the defined net changed-line threshold or approved size bucket requiring operator attention.
requiredEffects: Each novel size-policy finding identifies the pull request, the measured changed-line evidence, and the repository policy threshold or size bucket that was exceeded.
Maintainers can accept, reject, or resolve each surfaced finding using repository-linked evidence.
noopConditions: Every newly opened or updated covered pull request remains within the defined review-size threshold.
Every supported oversized-pull-request finding for the covered pull requests is already tracked or explicitly accepted.
successConditions: Supported oversized-pull-request findings receive accepted remediation evidence or an explicit maintainer dismissal within 10 days of the workflow run.
Pull requests that already satisfy the size policy create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: A documented exception may intentionally allow one oversized pull request to proceed when the review plan is explicitly accepted.
A pull request can cross the size threshold through later commits after initially complying with the policy.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel oversized-pull-request findings assigned to the run that are resolved or explicitly dismissed within 10 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported oversized-pull-request findings it assigns for newly opened or updated covered pull requests.
acceptedEvidence: A merged pull request update that reduces the identified pull request below the policy threshold through splitting, reverting, or otherwise shrinking the net changed lines before the evidence cutoff.
A closed tracking issue, pull request conversation, or repository-linked exception record that explicitly marks the oversized-pull-request finding resolved, dismissed, or accepted by a maintainer.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.

metric.name: resolved-supported-oversized-pull-request-findings
metric.formula: resolved-or-dismissed supported findings / supported novel oversized-pull-request findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 10 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel oversized-pull-request finding was assigned and none has accepted resolution evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned finding set or required repository pull request evidence for newly opened or updated covered pull requests cannot be read.
